mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, comment_weight, comment_count_cap, read_history_enabled, read_history_weight, read_history_recent_limit, updated_at FROM recommend_comment_config WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommend_comment_config (id, enabled, comment_weight, comment_count_cap, read_history_enabled, read_history_weight, read_history_recent_limit) VALUES (#{id}, #{enabled}, #{commentWeight}, #{commentCountCap}, #{readHistoryEnabled}, #{readHistoryWeight}, #{readHistoryRecentLimit})
mapper.update: UPDATE recommend_comment_config SET enabled = #{enabled}, comment_weight = #{commentWeight}, comment_count_cap = #{commentCountCap}, read_history_enabled = #{readHistoryEnabled}, read_history_weight = #{readHistoryWeight}, read_history_recent_limit = #{readHistoryRecentLimit} WHERE id = #{id}
